corpusNote: The five committed Apple SEC filings behind /explore (lib/explore-sample.w4.inputs.json): 2025 Form 10-K, 2026 Q1/Q2/Q3 Form 10-Q, 2026 DEF 14A proxy. 290 pages, 1,281 OCR regions. Public filings; no customer data.
authoring: Hand-authored 2026-09-11 by the evidence lane against the committed corpus. Every gold locator was read out of lib/explore-sample.w4.inputs.json, never inferred. The runner fails closed if any gold locator does not exist in the corpus.
knownBias: The questions are written in the corpus's own vocabulary, because a question a reader could not answer from the corpus either is not a retrieval test. Both paths evaluated here are lexical, so shared vocabulary between question and gold region flatters them. These are fixture numbers on one public corpus, not a product measurement and not a calibrated threshold.
goldSemantics: A gold locator is (documentId, pageNumber1, regionId) of a region that contains the answer. Several regions may be gold for one question. A question with an empty gold list is deliberately unanswerable from this corpus.
